Build the NLU benchmark harness on synthetic and public Darja data only
Build the CAPI transport, token handling and stuck-send reconciler behind an injected transport
Deploy the webhook ingress behind public HTTPS for the test number
Build the Yalidine and Ecotrack adapters against mocks
Test number smoke test: webhook delivery, signature, statuses, message flow into the store
Complete account setup: business verification, WABA, ad account and payment methods
Run a real click-to-WhatsApp entry and confirm ctwa_clid reaches the webhook through the chosen channel
Send a CAPI test event with DZD from the direct-developer path and audit clid selection
Open courier accounts and create sandbox parcels
Domestic payment-link rail experiment

scenarios.title: Direct path works
consequences: M1 can be the direct Cloud API; no BSP is required for conversion events.
F1 and F3 proceed as specified.

scenarios.title: Partner or BSP route required
consequences: TP1 or a BSP becomes the channel; M1 changes.
Policy rows gain the BSP as a provider; the referral must be re-verified through it (A-03).

scenarios.title: Counsel permits the extra flows
consequences: capi_meta, meta_business_agent and llm_hosted can be enabled once rows are decided.
Hosted LLM still needs written no-training terms (A-09, A-10).

scenarios.title: Counsel restricts the extra flows
consequences: No ctwa_clid or personal text leaves Z1 beyond the channel; conversion dispatch off.
Conversation runs on own_templates and own_encoder; attribution falls back to first-party measurement.

scenarios.title: Business Agent usable
consequences: B2 becomes an adapter behind the conversation port, per-intent by benchmark.
Token pricing enters the cost model (C0).

scenarios.title: Business Agent unavailable or unfit
consequences: Own runtime is the only conversation path; B4 and templates carry the load.

scenarios.title: Multi-merchant platform
consequences: TP1 required: business verification, App Review, Embedded Signup v4, business tokens, per-customer payment methods.
Our own positioning is scrutinised under the AI Providers clause (A-08).
Each merchant becomes a data controller relationship to document.

scenarios.title: Ad funding blocked
consequences: No own ad billing; ads run through an agency or partner account, which changes who owns the dataset and the clid.

scenarios.title: Our agent counts as an AI Provider
consequences: Use Meta's own agent only; stop shipping a separate LLM conversation layer on WhatsApp.
